create_gym_agent: create a GymAgent from a gym environment function with n_envs parallel environments and seeding
create_auto_reset_gym_agent: create an AutoResetGymAgent that automatically resets environments when done is True
create_no_auto_reset_gym_agent: create a NoAutoResetGymAgent that inherits GymAgent without automatic environment reset behavior
format_frame_to_tensor: format a gym observation frame into a batched PyTorch tensor using _format_frame
cat_dict_of_tensors: concatenate a list of observation dicts along dim 0 using _torch_cat_dict
